The '''OHS1782-03 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was a part of the region known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25,120 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], the system was known as the '''Xoraes system''' and was situated within the [[Kiirium/Legends|Kiirium]] Reaches region, a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Xoraes system was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Agon system/Legends|Turallun]], [[Jabiim system/Legends|Gwynhes Minor]], and [[OHS2132-04 system/Legends|Ulonsus systems]], and Xim moved his forces to the system from Ulonsus.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The OHS1782-03 system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-7.<ref name="TEA" />
